name: Arcane Library
description: A repository of magical knowledge. It supplies Insight at the parley table and researches cards the guild has not yet found.

tiers.description: A modest collection. +1 Insight card in every parley deck.
Research opens: commission an undiscovered card from the Card Library (2 at once, 3 lunations each). Still 1 Insight card in every parley deck.

3 commissions at once, and 2 Insight cards per parley. And a doctrine, chartered at the Grand Hall. The Forbidden Archives: research takes 2 lunations. Or the Chancery: every parley opens with your school's card in hand and every Lore term's valuation already read.

doctrines.name: The Forbidden Archives
doctrines.description: The deck is the product. Commissioned research delivers in 2 lunations instead of 3, so the Library becomes the guild's main card faucet.

doctrines.name: The Chancery
doctrines.description: The Library feeds the table. Every parley opens with one of your school's cards in hand (a sweeping one where your school has one), and every Lore term's valuation starts read.
